data_fields.name: step_loop_bound
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (progress recurses without a bound); sketch uses 8

best_idea: A quest is a per-character step machine (the current step is the state; progress() checks only that step's condition and stops at a terminal status), saved in the one character ledger, with cleanup run once from the terminal path.
decision_why: Keep the step machine and its status gate and store it in the one character ledger; express steps as zone data instead of per-quest classes; reject the per-quest attribute store.
acceptance: A server test: quest delivery on one character. The parcel event moves the step to B; a delivery event with 7 gold adds 10 XP once and the quest log reads 'You have completed this quest.'; a second delivery event adds nothing; after a server reload from the ledger, status and XP are unchanged.
